buildings.name: SEG Electronics Market
buildings.cn: 赛格电子市场 · 1002 Huaqiang N Rd
buildings.bestFor: Raw ICs, sensors, OLED displays, ESP32/STM32 boards & lab tools
buildings.metro: Huaqiang Rd (Line 1, Exit A) · Huaqiang North (Line 2/7, Exit D2)
buildings.moq: 1–10 pcs sample friendly on 1F–3F; reels/trays on 4F+

floors.desc: Raw components, resistors, connectors, OLED/LCD panels, ESP32/STM32/Raspberry Pi dev boards, soldering & lab tools.
Sensors (LiDAR, IMU, cameras), power modules, lithium cells, mini motors & robotics actuators.
Industrial PCs, embedded boards, POS terminals, custom display controllers, and small-batch assembly desks.

buildings.tip: Walk 1F–3F with a printed BOM table (part number + qty + target price). Booths quote wholesale tiers faster when they see exact IC codes.

buildings.name: Huaqiang Electronics World · HQ-Mart
buildings.cn: 华强电子世界 · 1015 Huaqiang N Rd
buildings.bestFor: IC distributors, PCB/PCBA quick-turn desks & AI smart wearables
buildings.moq: Mixed: 1 pc for dev kits & LEDs; 50–500 pcs for OEM enclosures

floors.desc: IC distributors, connectors, cables, micro-displays, LED drivers, and PCB/PCBA quick-turn broker desks.
AI smart glasses demos, mini projectors, smart wearables, audio modules, and white-label 3C gadgets.
Refurbished parts, industrial power supplies, and B2B trading offices.

buildings.tip: Compare identical IC quotes across 3 booths here vs. SEG Plaza—price spreads on uncommon chips can exceed 25%.

buildings.name: Yuanwang Digital Mall
buildings.cn: 远望数码商城 · 2006 Huaqiang N Rd
buildings.bestFor: 2F AI/Robot pavilion, GaN chargers, smartphones & export packaging
buildings.moq: 5–20 units for wholesale pricing; single-unit retail available

floors.desc: AI gadget & consumer robot showcases, GaN chargers, magnetic power banks, cases, and export-ready packaging.
Wholesale smartphones, tablets, wearables, and cross-border electronics fulfillment counters.

buildings.tip: Confirm whether quotes include export battery certification (UN38.3 / MSDS) before paying deposits.

buildings.name: Manha Digital Plaza
buildings.cn: 曼哈数码广场 · 2001 Huaqiang N Rd
buildings.bestFor: New AI consumer gadgets, smart glasses, FPV drones & creator gear
buildings.moq: 1–5 units sample buy; 100+ units custom logo OEM

floors.desc: AI hardware gadgets (voice recorders, smart rings, AI glasses, pocket translators), consumer drones & FPV parts.
Creator lighting, wireless mics, action camera rigs, and trending Amazon/TikTok 3C samples.

buildings.tip: Best hall for spotting newly launched AI consumer gadgets before they appear on Western e-commerce platforms.

buildings.name: Feiyang & Tongtiandi Hub
buildings.cn: 飞扬时代 / 通天地 · Zhenhua Rd
buildings.bestFor: OLED replacement screens, flex cables, camera modules & board repair
buildings.metro: Science Museum (Line 1/6, Exit C) · 8 min walk south

floors.desc: Replacement OLED screens, camera sensors, flex cables, micro-soldering fixtures, and phone testing rigs.
Board-level diagnostic equipment and bulk refurbishing suppliers.

buildings.tip: Do not arrive at 9:30 AM—most wholesale stalls here open after lunch around 13:00.

buildings.name: SEG Communications Market
buildings.cn: 赛格通信市场 · 1012 Huaqiang N Rd
buildings.bestFor: Smartphone accessories, smartwatches, Bluetooth earbuds & small-MOQ packaging
buildings.metro: Huaqiang North (Line 2/7, Exit D2) · adjacent to SEG Plaza

floors.desc: Cases, screen protectors, USB-C cables, TWS audio modules, and smartwatch straps.
Custom retail gift boxes, blister inserts, and barcode labeling booths (same-day sample printing).

buildings.tip: Ideal stop if you need retail packaging prototypes printed the same afternoon after sourcing electronics in SEG Plaza.

buildings.name: Modern Window Digital Plaza
buildings.cn: 现代之窗数码广场 · 1058 Huaqiang N Rd
buildings.bestFor: Cameras, cinema lenses, studio lighting, gimbals & audio gear
buildings.moq: 1 unit retail/creator friendly; bulk pricing on lights & tripods

floors.desc: New and pre-owned mirrorless cameras, cine lenses, DJI gimbals, and action-cam mounts.
LED studio lights, carbon tripods, shotgun mics, and repair workshops.

buildings.tip: Pitfall alert: Skip Mingtong Cosmetics Market (明通化妆品市场) nearby—despite old blog posts, it converted into wholesale beauty products, not electronics.

walkingRoutes.title: Engineer & BOM Sourcing Walk
walkingRoutes.sub: ICs, ESP32/STM32, sensors, PCBA desks & same-day sample boxes
walkingRoutes.brief: Start at Huaqiang Rd Exit A → walk 1F–3F of SEG Plaza with your printed BOM → cross north to HQ-Mart (1F–2F) to compare chip & PCBA broker quotes → finish next door at SEG Comm (3F) for custom retail box samples.

walkingRoutes.title: AI Gadgets, FPV & Creator Gear
walkingRoutes.sub: Smart glasses, consumer robotics, drones, GaN chargers & camera rigs
walkingRoutes.brief: Exit Huaqiang North Exit A/B → check AI wearables on HQ-Mart 3F–4F → walk north to Manha Plaza (1F–2F) for newly launched AI gadgets & FPV drones → compare GaN/3C export packs at Yuanwang → inspect gimbals & studio lights at Modern Window.

walkingRoutes.title: Smartphones, OLEDs & Repair Hub
walkingRoutes.sub: Wholesale phones, cases, replacement screens & micro-soldering tools
walkingRoutes.brief: Repair hubs sleep in — do not arrive at 9:30 AM. Start at 13:00 inside Yuanwang (3F–4F) for wholesale handsets → stop next door at SEG Comm (1F–2F) for cases and TWS accessories → walk south to Feiyang & Tongtiandi after 13:30 when OLED screen and board-repair stalls peak.

boothPhrases.en: Can I buy 1–2 samples today? What is the unit price for 100 pcs?
boothPhrases.zh: 老板好，这款今天可以拿 1–2 个样品吗？100 个起订的单价是多少？
boothPhrases.py: Lǎobǎn hǎo, zhè kuǎn jīntiān kěyǐ ná yī liǎng gè yàngpǐn ma? Yībǎi gè qǐdìng de dānjià shì duōshǎo?

boothPhrases.en: Is this brand-new original stock? What is the manufacturing date code (DC)?
boothPhrases.zh: 请问这是全新原装正品吗？是什么年份批次（DC）的货？
boothPhrases.py: Qǐngwèn zhè shì quánxīn yuánzhuāng zhèngpǐn ma? Shì shénme niánfèn pīcì (DC) de huò?

boothPhrases.en: Can I add your WeChat to get the English datasheet and tiered price sheet?
boothPhrases.zh: 方便加个微信，发一份英文规格书（Datasheet）和阶梯报价单给我吗？
boothPhrases.py: Fāngbiàn jiā gè Wēixìn, fā yī fèn Yīngwén guīgéshū hé jiētī bàojìadān gěi wǒ ma?

boothPhrases.en: Does this lithium-battery product have UN38.3, MSDS, and CE/FCC reports for international air shipping?
boothPhrases.zh: 这款带锂电池的产品有 UN38.3、MSDS 和 CE/FCC 认证报告吗？我们要发国际空运。
boothPhrases.py: Zhè kuǎn dài lǐdiànchí de chǎnpǐn yǒu UN38.3, MSDS hé CE/FCC rènzhèng bàogào ma? Wǒmen yào fā guójì kōngyùn.

boothPhrases.en: What is the MOQ and lead time in days if we customize our own logo and retail box?
boothPhrases.zh: 如果定制我们自己的 Logo 和包装盒，起订量（MOQ）多少？交期几天？
boothPhrases.py: Rúguǒ dìngzhì wǒmen zìjǐ de Logo hé bāozhuānghé, qǐdìngliàng (MOQ) duōshǎo? Jiāoqī jǐ tiān?

boothPhrases.en: Do you own an SMT or assembly factory in Bao'an or Dongguan that we can visit this week?
boothPhrases.zh: 你们在宝安或东莞有自己的贴片/组装工厂吗？这两天方便去参观吗？
boothPhrases.py: Nǐmen zài Bǎo'ān huò Dōngguǎn yǒu zìjǐ de tiēpiàn / zǔzhuāng gōngchǎng ma? Zhè liǎng tiān fāngbiàn qù cānguān ma?
